senses.gloss: m. (comp. of מדע, v. preced., a. enclitic מ for מא) [noticeable,] something; anything (corresp. to h. מְאוּם, מְאוּמָה or דָּבָר).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:7">Targ. Job XXXI, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 22:12">Targ. Gen. XXII, 12</cite> (Y. Levita <cite ref="M01720"><he>מִנְדַּעַם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 17:1">Targ. Deut. XVII, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 51b:6">Bekh. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>מי׳ ביש עבדת</he> (Rashi a. Tosaf.) thou didst something wrong (in giving the redemption money with the expectation of getting it refunded).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 55a:14">Snh. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>אמי׳ אחרינא וכ׳</he> for doing something else (unnatural gratification) he ought not to be punished. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 2 <he>מן מ׳ מסאבא</he> from anything unclean.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 123a:12">B. Bath. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מהניא … ולא מ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="M01094"><he>מידי</he></cite>) would Joseph have been given no preference whatever?; a. e.—V. <cite ref="M01094"><he>מִידֵּי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01096"><he>מֵידַם</he></cite>.
